title: IT Project Coordinator(West Bengal Candidates apply only)
description:
**IT Project Coordinator(West Bengal Candidates apply only)**

**Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.**  
**Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary:** ₹30,000 – ₹35,000 per month  
**Experience:** 2–3 years  
**Qualification:** B.Tech preferred  
**Preferred Academic Background:** Mathematics / Physics / Engineering  
**Immediate Joiners:** Preferred

Job Overview

Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced **IT Project Coordinator** with **2–3 years of hands\-on experience in IT project coordination and project handling**. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating project activities, tracking timelines, communicating with technical teams and stakeholders, and ensuring projects are delivered smoothly and on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate and monitor **end\-to\-end IT project activities**.
* Work closely with developers, QA teams, UI/UX teams and other technical departments.
* Track project **scope, timelines, milestones and deliverables**.
* Prepare and maintain project plans, schedules and status reports.
* Coordinate daily/weekly project meetings and follow up on action items.
* Communicate project updates, issues and dependencies to management.
* Identify project risks, delays and dependencies and escalate them when required.
* Ensure tasks are assigned to the appropriate team members and followed up regularly.
* Coordinate with clients/stakeholders regarding project requirements and progress.
* Maintain project documentation, meeting minutes and project trackers.
* Follow up with technical teams to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Support requirement gathering and ensure proper communication between business and technical teams.
* Monitor project progress and provide regular updates to management.
* Assist in resolving project\-related issues and coordination gaps.
* Ensure project deliverables are completed according to agreed timelines and requirements.

Required Skills

* 2–3 years of experience in **IT Project Coordination / Project Management / Project Handling**.
* Hands\-on experience coordinating **software/IT projects**.
* Good understanding of the **software development lifecycle (SDLC)**.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel, MS Office and project tracking tools**.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-up, documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical teams.
* Good problem\-solving and organizational skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Educational Qualification:\-

* **B.Tech / B.E. preferred.**
* Candidates with an academic background in **Mathematics, Physics or Engineering** will be preferred.
